title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Hate Speech Detection Using a Data Augmentation Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-dataset performance by training hate speech classifiers on source domains and evaluating them on target domains with different demographic targets, vocabularies, and linguistic variations to measure the generalization gap.

Measuring the impact of training data heavily skewed by a small number of prolific users by comparing model performance on original datasets versus user-debiased datasets where individual user contributions are capped.
